Convert between naboer folds and rsample resamples

Source: R/rsample.R
as_rset.Rd

Analysis sets are the complement of omission sets. Assessment membership is preserved independently, including exclusion-only observations in buffered designs. Bootstrap resamples with duplicated analysis rows are not supported. Resamples must index individual observations. Convert nested cubbles to their temporal face before creating resamples; spatial-row indices cannot safely be reused after expanding nested temporal observations. Exported manual rsets retain column metadata for series keys, index, independent domains and observation identifiers. Import restores it unless explicit tidy selections override it. External rsets can supply these selections directly.

Usage

as_rset(x, max_bytes = getOption("naboer.max_bytes", 1024^3))

from_rset(x, id = NULL, key = NULL, index = NULL, .by = NULL)

Arguments

x

A naboer_folds object for as_rset(), or an rsample rset for from_rset().

max_bytes

Maximum estimated storage for analysis and assessment indices exported to rsample, in bytes. Defaults to option naboer.max_bytes, or 1 GiB. The estimate excludes R object overhead. Use Inf to disable the memory guard after checking the design size.

id

Optional unique observation identifier column, using tidy selection.

key, index, .by

Tidy selections of series keys, temporal index and independent domains. Omitted selections restore metadata saved by as_rset(), or use native tsibble/cubble metadata where available.

Value

as_rset() returns an rsample manual rset; from_rset() returns a naboer_folds object.
